maya-glm-dual-xtx.name: Maya HIP Maya-M IQ2_S dual RX 7900 XTX

hardware.added_gpus: 2 x AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (1002:744c), each on its own PCIe 4.0 x4 link
hardware.helper_gpu: AMD Radeon 8060S (1002:1586) computes each card's routed experts held in RAM

draft.placement: the model's own next-token layer, no separate draft model

maya-glm-dual-xtx.layer_split: layers 0-24 on the first card, the rest on the second (MAYA_GLM_SPLIT=25)
maya-glm-dual-xtx.context_scaling_note: Each point: a fresh load, the public prompt bytes of the DeepSeek rows (GLM counts fewer tokens for the same text), thinking off, 256-token cap (answers used 52-61 tokens), zero cached input. 2K-64K at a 131,072-token allocation, 128K-240K at 262,144, 480K at 524,288; the 128K prompt read at 907.1 tok/s and decoded at 55.8 at 131,072. The retrieval filler routes to few experts, so its prefill is faster than real text (long_context).

maya-ds4-gsq-dual-xtx.name: Maya DS4 HIP GSQ-RCO IQ2_XS dual RX 7900 XTX

hardware.added_gpus: 2 x AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (1002:744c), each on its own PCIe 4.0 x4 link
hardware.helper_gpu: AMD Radeon 8060S (1002:1586) serves routed experts beside the two cards

runtime.upstream: https://github.com/mw00/project-maya v1.1.48 plus RDNA 3 indexer v3 (DS4_INDEX_TC=1)

target.quantization: ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO IQ2_XS + IQ4_NL Engram; 522 original Q5_K dense tensors, embedding/head Q8_0

draft.placement: blocks split across the two cards: block 0 on the second card, blocks 1 and 2 on the lead (DS4_DRAFT_DEV=1,0,0)

quality.scoring: Coding execution and reviewed final answers; frozen math_08 reference20/3.

reused_prompt.aggregation: median of the three per-load means, each of three consecutive cached answers

long_context.aggregation: median of three loads, each starting from the same frozen profile

maya-ds4-gsq-dual-xtx.context_scaling_note: Each point: a fresh load from the frozen expert profile, no conversation kept from an earlier point, thinking off, 256-token cap, zero cached input, at the 524,288-token allocation. The same pinned 114 procedure and inputs as the public comparison setups.

maya_bench.procedure: Project Maya v1.1.28's maya.py --bench, DeepSeek on HIP: three 256-token answers (greedy, thinking off; decode is their mean) and 2,048- and 8,192-token prompts of its docs, the engine alone, both engines on identical token ids
maya_bench.aggregation: median of three per-load decode means; prefill from the load with that median decode mean

maya-ds4-gsq-dual-xtx.qualification_note: Pinned v1.1.48 plus RDNA 3 indexer v3 (DS4_INDEX_TC=1), explicit 32768 chunks. One complete retrieval curve, 30 cold reviewed quality cases and PPL on this exact recipe. Real-code and native speed medians from three loads, cached speed the median of three per-load three-answer means. Same pinned GSQ pack, frozen profile, drafter, 512K allocation and memory/power settings. Indexer scores change generated text; cold and cached decode are not stream-matched causal comparisons.
